senses.gloss: शुभ्रादि a class of words headed by the word शुभ्र to which the tadd- hita affix एय ( ढक् ) is added in the sense of a descendant in spite of other affixes being prescribed by some other rules which some- times are added optionally with this एय; e.g. शौभ्रय:, वैधवेय: रौहिणेयः. This class is looked upon as अाकृति- गण and hence if this affix एय is seen applied although not prescri- bed actually as in the word गाङ्गेय, the word is supposed to have been included in this class; cf. P. IV. 1.123.
